full_text:
Gil is a 30 year-old researcher for the Huntik Foundation, his job being to analyse artifacts in case there are Titans hidden in them.

History

Gil was attacked by Gregor and Ford and was frozen by Frostanna. Ryder disguised himself as Gil and infiltrated the Huntik team's mission. However, he was supposedly rescued by Zhalia Moon, and him and Zhalia later rescued the other members of the Huntik team from Ryder by speedboat. [The Fire of Georgiopolis]

Abilities

Gil is quite strong as he is able to demobilize Gregor with a punch.

'''Gil''' is a 30 year-old researcher for the [[Huntik Foundation]], his job being to analyse artifacts in case there are [[Titans]] hidden in them.

== History ==
Gil was attacked by [[Gregor]] and [[Ford]] and was frozen by [[Frostanna]]. Ryder disguised himself as Gil and infiltrated the Huntik team's mission. However, he was supposedly rescued by [[Zhalia Moon]], and him and Zhalia later rescued the other members of the Huntik team from [[Ryder]] by speedboat. {{Source|The Fire of Georgiopolis}}

== Abilities ==
Gil is quite strong as he is able to demobilize Gregor with a punch.
